verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Snyk supports ignoring/suppressing specific findings and has 'Policy management' features, which directly maps to baselining/ignoring false positives so only new issues surface. However, the evidence is thin — no detail on ignore-reason workflows, expiry dates, audit trails, or baseline-scan diffing that security engineers typically need. Missing for 10: detailed ignore-policy workflow docs, false-positive marking UI/CLI specifics, baseline comparison logic, independent confirmation the feature works as intended.
